name: PandoLogic
notes: Site says: "leverages the best of programmatic technology with conversational AI" Site says: "PandoLogic is now Veritone Hire" Site says: "pandoIQ is PandoLogic’s programmatic job advertising platform that intelligently automates job advertising placement across PandoLogic’s network of thousands of job sites." Programmatic job advertising (pandoIQ) across a network of job sites. Homepage says PandoLogic is now Veritone Hire. No pricing, language switcher or API found on the pages read.

review.note: Homepage and partners page state an Irvine, CA address and a partner program; no pricing, language switcher or API was stated.
